items.title: Navitas Soars 8% on onsemi’s 175% AI Data Center Jump Ahead of Its Own Report
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNavitas Semiconductor jumped 8% today after onsemi said its AI data center revenue grew 175% from a year earlier. onsemi’s $600 million deal for Ferric puts a much bigger rival in the race Navitas is running.

items.title: ON Semiconductor earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- ON Semiconductor (ON) beat on both lines in Q3 FY2026 (reported Nov 2, 2026), yet the stock fell 2.18% to $70.11 and slipped further after hours. It is now rebounding: $72.92, +4.01% as of Nov 3, 12:49 PM EST. The pattern is familiar. The company has beaten EPS four quarters running, with surprises of 3–5%. The price reaction has been muted or negative in three of those four.

items.title: ON Semiconductor (ON) Stock Looks Fairly Valued After AI Revenue News
items.summary: ON Semiconductor has delivered a strong 38.9% gain over the past year, even as recent weeks have been choppy. With investors focused on AI related demand and acquisitions, the question now is how much of that story is already reflected in the stock.
